messages:
alex: Heads-up — PR #7210 is failing CI on the Azure integration job (integration-azure). This is blocking the canary roll; tagging @jess and @sam for visibility :eyes:

alex: Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/7210

alex: Failing test is `kv-cache-invalidation.test.ts` — looks like a timing issue. CI log snippet:
```
Error: timeout waiting for cache invalidation after 30s
    at Object.invalidate (/root/workspace/packages/kv/src/cache.ts:142:13)
    at Test.<anonymous> (packages/kv/tests/kv-cache-invalidation.test.ts:58:7)
```

jess: ugh, that one's been flaky on Azure lately. Usually a race between the invalidation signal and the mock federation. Can you paste the full job id so I can rerun the matrix?

alex: job 4578 (integration-azure, linux-x86, node18). I tried a local repro with `yarn test packages/kv --testNamePattern="invalidat"` and couldn't reproduce.

sam: I can take a bisect tomorrow morning if reruns don't help. For short term — can we rerun the failed job and see? If it passes once it's likely flaky, but we should add a retry wrapper or increase timeout.

daria: please don't do a snapshot update here — this is behavior, not a snapshot mismatch. If we update snapshots we might mask the regression.

alex: Agreed. @ci-bot can you trigger a rerun for job 4578?

ci-bot: Rerun requested by alex — restarting job 4578 (integration-azure, linux-x86, node18). Status: queued. :repeat:

ci-bot: Job 4578 started.

ci-bot: Job 4578 finished — FAILURE. Same test timed out again.

jess: ok that's two failures in a row on Azure. Could be infra flake or a real race. Can you add logging around the invalidate path so we can see timestamps? Something like:
```js
console.debug('invalidate start', Date.now(), key);
await this._invalidateImpl(key);
console.debug('invalidate done', Date.now(), key);
```

alex: I pushed a tiny commit with extra logs and a 10s buffer on the timeout (for diagnostics) — PR updated. Triggering CI again.

ci-bot: Rerun requested by alex — job 4621 started.

ci-bot: Job 4621 finished — SUCCESS. All tests green.

sam: Since it passed after adding logs and timeout bump, I'd prefer a safer fix than just increasing the timer. Maybe add a small retry loop in the test around the invalidate check (3x with 200ms backoff) and file a follow-up issue to investigate root cause.

jess: +1. Also we should mark the test with `@flaky` tag in mocha for the azure matrix while we triage, so it doesn't block canary merges.

daria: Who has approval rights to merge this today? We need a second approver before the canary deploy.

alex: I'm good to ship once @jess or @sam approves. I'd like to merge before EOD to unblock the canary.

sam: reviewing now. I left one tiny comment about the log message wording, otherwise LGTM. Approving the PR. :+1:

jess: Approving as well after discussion — but please open an issue to track the root cause and the retry/fix. If flakiness persists we'll put a short-term skip for azure and copy to flaky tests board. :shipit:

alex: Thanks all — merging after CI passthrough and will create issue #1294 to track root cause + revert plan if it reappears.

alex: If it flaps again post-merge, we'll revert and revert the canary.

ci-bot: Merge completed by alex — PR #7210 merged. Canary deploy will run at 18:00 UTC. :rocket:
